transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve been feeling like everything that goes wrong is somehow my fault. Like I’m just failing at work, and at home too. I keep thinking I’m a bad employee and… a bad homeowner, I guess. Like maybe I deserve to lose what I’ve worked for.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time lately?
I… I don’t know. I’ve felt pretty low, I guess, but “most of the time” is hard to say.
Have you been enjoying things you usually like to do?

Not really. I used to plan brunches, paint in the spare room, go hiking… even sign up for networking things. Lately it all just feels like stuff I’m supposed to care about, not things I actually want to do.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been… a long time. A little over two years, I think. About two years and a month.
Do you still find pleasure in the things you're doing, even if you're not motivated to start them?
Not really. Even when I make myself do them—like painting or going out—it just feels kind of flat. Like I’m going through the motions, pretending I care.
Have you had any periods in the last two years where you felt significantly better for a while?
Not really. I mean… maybe a few short stretches where I could get through things a little easier, but the low feeling and not caring about stuff has pretty much been there the whole time.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months where you didn't feel this low?
No… I don’t think so. Looking back, it’s been there most of the time. Maybe I had short bits where I could handle things a little better, but not two months where I wasn’t feeling low.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?
Yeah… I think so. I used to actually want to plan brunches, paint in the spare room, go hiking, even sign up for networking things. Now it all just feels like… chores. Like I’m pretending to care.
Have you experienced significant weight loss or gain since you started feeling this way?

Yeah… I think I’ve lost some weight. I’m not really tracking it, but my clothes feel looser. My appetite’s been weird—I’ll skip meals most of the day and then just have coffee, toast, whatever’s easy.
Have you had any episodes in the past where you felt really down, and then they went away for a while before coming back?

Not really… I mean, I’ve had maybe short stretches where I was functioning a little better, but it didn’t really go away. The low feeling and not caring about things have been there pretty much the whole time since it started.
Have you ever had a period where you felt completely back to your normal self, without these low feelings and loss of interest, before they started again?

No… I don’t think there’s been a time where I felt fully normal again. Maybe brief stretches where I could get through things a little better, but the low feeling and not really caring have mostly stayed there.
Have you experienced any periods of significant improvement that lasted for at least two weeks?

Yeah… there was maybe a few weeks where I wasn’t quite as weighed down. I was getting through work more normally. But it wasn’t like everything was fine… I was still hearing the voice by the vents, and I still felt like the mortgage company and people at work were watching me.
You mentioned hearing a voice by the vents, can you tell me more about that?

It’s… usually like a woman’s voice. I hear it in the hallway or sometimes like it’s coming through the air vent. She says things like, “You’re going to lose it all.”

It sounds real enough that I’ve gone outside to check if someone was there. Usually no one is.
Has there been a period of at least two years where you consistently felt this low and disconnected from things you used to enjoy?
Yeah… it’s been about that long. A little over two years, I think—maybe two years and a month—with the depression and not really enjoying things.
Have you felt this low for most of every day for the past two years?
Yeah… most days, for most of the day. It’s been going on about two years and a month, the depression and not really caring about things.
Have you experienced any other unusual perceptions or beliefs besides the voice by the vents?

Yeah… I guess. I don’t really like talking about it, but even when I’m having an okay day, I still feel pretty sure the mortgage company and people at work are watching for me to mess up. Like they’re waiting to prove I’m irresponsible so they can take my townhouse.
Have you had more than one distinct period of feeling this low and disconnected from things you used to enjoy over the past two years?
Not really more than one… it’s felt like the same thing just kind of going on. The low mood and not caring about much has been there for about two years and a month.
Have you had an episode like this before the one that started about two years ago?
I don’t think so… not like this. I mean, I’ve had bad patches before, but I can’t really point to an episode like the one that started then.
Have you had another episode of feeling this low before the one that started about two years ago ended?
No… I mean, it didn’t really end. The depression and not being interested in things has just been there for about two years and a month.
Have you ever had an episode of depression like this one before it started about two years ago?
Not that I can really remember. I had rough times, but… I wouldn’t say it was like this before.
